python3 -c "
from PIL import Image
for name in ['dual-beacon-tag-b-cu', 'dual-beacon-tag-f-cu', 'dual-beacon-tag-schematic']:
    path = f'final-out/dual-beacon-tag/visual/png/{name}.png'
    img = Image.open(path)
    # Count non-transparent pixels
    if img.mode == 'RGBA':
        pixels = img.load()
        non_transparent = sum(1 for x in range(img.width) for y in range(img.height) if pixels[x, y][3] > 0)
    else:
        non_transparent = img.width * img.height
    print(f'{name}: size={img.size}, mode={img.mode}, non_transparent_pixels={non_transparent}')
"
